title: Frigid
subtitle: Congeatio — cold, ice, stillness
text: Frigid blood is Congeatio: the quiet bite of winter and the slow certainty of ice. It favors control, patience, preservation, and the deliberate refusal to panic. Blood cooled by Congeatio does not rush. It outlasts whatever it is set against, wearing it down with the certainty that cold has always had the final word. The Frigid enzyme is simply the handle Hemomancers use to work with it.
